from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """One reference this paper makes to another provided paper."""
    referenced_paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the other provided paper that this paper references")
    reference_location: str | None = Field(description="Where in this paper the reference appears (e.g., bibliography, citations, footnotes)")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt showing the reference")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and what other provided papers it references."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    author: str | None = Field(description="Author(s) as named in this paper")
    year: int | None = Field(description="Publication year if stated")
    references_provided_papers: list[PaperReference] = Field(description="All references this paper makes to OTHER provided papers in the collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
